text:
"Listen, Josefa, and take care, for now you tread

        this court of the king; have prudence;

        remember that the crowd takes revenge by murmuring,

        and time always warns without speaking.


        By our holy and heavenly emblem,

        refrain from speaking with princes,

        and though one duke and another come to see you,

        let your husband be all: your honor, your mass."


        Morales said this and prayed his little prayer,

        but Josefa answers him angrily:

        "Oh, may the devil take so much bogeyman-guarding!


        Curse me if I were any more honorable!"

        But since she is simple and he is mad,

        she looked sideways, left, and nothing happened.

translation.title: To Josefa Vaca, Reprimanded by Her Husband
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the comic dialogue of reputation, court gossip, and Josefa's impatient retort.
